name: Damaris
overview: Damaris is a female figure noted in the New Testament as the woman who believed the Apostle Paul during his ministry in Athens. familyAndRelationships: Scripture does not record any family relationships for Damaris beyond her identification as a believer who responded to Paul's message. No additional relational details are given in the biblical account.
